name: Ruby
description: Ruby is a language of simplicity and productivity, famous for the Rails web framework. It prioritizes developer happiness and elegant code with a philosophy of convention over configuration. These are the definitive free resources — vetted, current, and complete.

items.title: Why's (Poignant) Guide to Ruby
items.description: A wildly creative comic-illustrated cult classic that introduces Ruby through storytelling and humor.

items.title: Learn Ruby the Hard Way
items.description: A classic problem-driven book taking beginners from absolute zero to writing basic Ruby through repetition and explicit exercises.

items.title: Ruby Essentials
items.description: A concise step-by-step guide covering everything from installation to fundamentals of the Ruby language.

items.title: ruby-lang.org Documentation
items.description: The central portal for official language guides, API references, and getting-started resources.

items.title: Ruby-Doc.org
items.description: The long-standing community-hosted API documentation for core classes and standard libraries.

items.title: RubyAPI.org
items.description: A blazing-fast modern mobile-friendly interface for browsing Ruby classes, modules, and methods.

items.title: The Odin Project — Full Stack Ruby on Rails
items.description: A world-class rigorous 100% free curriculum starting with Ruby fundamentals through OOP and into Rails.

items.title: freeCodeCamp — Ruby Course
items.description: Free comprehensive Ruby tutorials and full courses covering everything from basics to Ruby on Rails.

items.title: Ruby Programming Full Course (freeCodeCamp)
items.description: A multi-hour comprehensive video tutorial covering Ruby from scratch to professional proficiency.

items.title: Ruby on Rails Course (freeCodeCamp)
items.description: Full Rails course covering MVC architecture, Active Record, routing, and deploying real applications.

items.title: Exercism — Ruby Track
items.description: 121 community-sourced exercises with 100% free personal code mentoring from volunteer experts.

items.title: Codewars
items.description: Solve community-crafted algorithmic challenges filtered by Ruby across hundreds of kata.

items.title: HackerRank — Ruby Domain
items.description: Practice Ruby-specific challenges from basic control structures to advanced language paradigms.

items.title: DevDocs Ruby Reference
items.description: A lightning-fast searchable aggregator containing comprehensive offline-friendly Ruby documentation.

items.title: Ruby Style Guide
items.description: The definitive community-agreed style guide enforced by RuboCop for writing idiomatic Ruby code.

items.title: Ruby Weekly
items.description: A free popular weekly email newsletter curating the best Ruby articles, updates, and tutorials since 2010.

items.title: Short Ruby Newsletter
items.description: A concise Monday morning summary of community discussions, news, and releases from the Ruby world.

items.title: Reddit r/ruby
items.description: The primary community hub for Ruby discussions, troubleshooting, and news.

items.title: Ruby Discord
items.description: Real-time chat community to connect with fellow Ruby developers and get immediate help.

items.title: Ruby-Lang Community Page
items.description: The official listing of Ruby community resources including mailing lists, IRC channels, and user groups.

lessons.title: Variables and Data Types
lessons.description: Local/instance/class/global variables, dynamic typing, symbols.

lessons.title: Numbers and Arithmetic
lessons.description: Integer/Float semantics, operators, precision, and big numbers.

lessons.title: Strings and String Methods
lessons.description: String manipulation, interpolation, formatting, and mutation.

lessons.title: Control Flow
lessons.description: if/elsif/else, case/when, unless, and loops.

lessons.title: Arrays
lessons.description: Indexing, slicing, sorting, and Enumerable-powered transformation.

lessons.title: Hashes and Symbols
lessons.description: Hash construction, symbol keys, iteration, and transformation.

lessons.title: Methods and Arguments
lessons.description: Method definitions, implicit returns, splat, keyword args, blocks.

lessons.title: Classes and Objects
lessons.description: Class definitions, initialize, attr_*, self, to_s.

lessons.title: Modules and Mixins

lessons.title: Inheritance
lessons.description: Subclassing, super, override, and ancestry.

lessons.title: Blocks, Procs, and Lambdas

lessons.title: Enumerable Module

lessons.title: Exceptions and Error Handling
lessons.description: begin/rescue/ensure, custom exceptions, raise.

lessons.title: File I/O
lessons.description: File read/write, blocks, iteration, FileUtils.

lessons.title: Regular Expressions
lessons.description: =~, match, scan, gsub, anchors, captures.

lessons.title: Metaprogramming
lessons.description: define_method, method_missing, send, instance_eval.

lessons.title: Gems, Bundler, and Standard Library
lessons.description: Gems, JSON, dates, Net::HTTP, and the standard library.

lessons.title: Testing with Minitest
lessons.description: assertions, test classes, describe/it, mocks.

lessons.title: Threads and Concurrency
lessons.description: Thread.new, Mutex, Queue, Fiber.

lessons.title: Advanced: Pattern Matching and Refinements
lessons.description: Case/in patterns, guards, and refinements.
